title: All-dimension orbital-restoration stability law
statement: Positive denominator ordering between q^(d-1) gravity and q^3 centrifugal response forces restoring circular orbits for d=2,3, exact marginality at d=4 and nonrestoring response for every d at least five.

candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive whole d at least two and every exact outward q above One.

intended_certificate: All 2,916 forms, one engine survivor, independent reconstruction, hostile controls and all fourteen post-seal comparison rows.
